fields.name: SpanParser primary-key span conversion family
fields.contract: SpanParser provides one in-place serialization and sequential deserialization family for delimiter-separated UTF-8 key values. Append writes a value at the caller's current buffer position, prefixes every noninitial value with ASCII '+', and returns the first unwritten position. The family accepts Guid; signed and unsigned 64-, 32-, 16-, and 8-bit integers; decimal; string; and ReadOnlySpan<byte>. Guid values use 32 hexadecimal digits; numeric values use hexadecimal text; text and raw bytes substitute byte 0x1D for embedded '+'. Extract consumes the next '+'-delimited segment from a ReadOnlySpan<byte>, populates the requested supported type, and returns the unconsumed suffix. GetDbGrainId<TModel> returns the IdSpan created for a non-null database model's generic type.
